booster.name: Armed Resupply Pods
booster.text: Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets.

booster.name: Concealed Insertion
booster.text: Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment.

booster.name: Dead Sprint
booster.text: Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead.

booster.name: Experimental Infusion
booster.text: In addition to restoring health, stims temporarily increase movement speed and damage reduction.

booster.name: Expert Extraction Pilot
booster.text: Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon.

booster.name: Firebomb Hellpods
booster.text: Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site.

booster.name: Flexible Reinforcement Budget
booster.text: Reduce time until new reinforcements are granted once they've been depleted.

booster.name: Hellpod Space Optimization
booster.text: Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades, and Stims.

booster.name: Increased Reinforcement Budget
booster.text: Increases the number of available reinforcements.

booster.name: Integrated Extinguishers
booster.text: Equips Helldiver uniforms with form-fitting, automated, rapid-response fire suppression systems. Significantly reduces the time it takes to naturally extinguish flames without conducting ground-aided smothering manuevers.

booster.name: Localization Confusion
booster.text: Increases the time between enemy encounters.

booster.name: Motivational Shocks
booster.text: Allows all Helldivers to recover faster after being slowed by an attack, such as acid. Does not mitigate “area effects,” such as EMS strikes.

booster.name: Muscle Enhancement
booster.text: Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease.

booster.name: Sample Extricator
booster.text: Large enemies now have a chance of dropping Samples on death. Capped at 10 drops per mission.

booster.name: Sample Scanner
booster.text: The Sample scanner gives you a 15% chance to receive twice the Samples on sample pick up.

booster.name: Stamina Enhancement
booster.text: Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery.

booster.name: Stun Pods
booster.text: Exposes Hellpod wiring upon surface contact, stunning any units in the vicinity of the drop site.

booster.name: Surplus EAT Allocation
booster.text: Grants two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol.

booster.name: UAV Recon Booster
booster.text: Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range.

booster.name: Vitality Enhancement
booster.text: Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers.
